derivation: Within when the two ends carry the same territory, cross otherwise. CAVEAT: a declaration reached by several roots was assigned one territory by the tie break of the territory labeling, nearest root then smaller territory then least name, so the locality of an edge touching such a declaration follows that choice and is not independent structure. Read a cross edge at a shared endpoint as a consequence of the tie break, not as a fact about the dependency.
title: Whether a dependency stays inside one territory or binds two together.
